## Description
Briefly describe the purpose of this pull request, the problem it solves, or the feature it introduces.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / performance improvement

## Checklist
- [ ] I have run all automated test suites via `npm run test:all` and all tests pass.
- [ ] I have tested startup via `npm start -- --test-mode` to ensure no runtime errors occur.
- [ ] I have verified that no pairing PINs, passwords, or personal credentials are saved to disk or logged.
- [ ] I have preserved Electron security settings (`contextIsolation: true`, `nodeIntegration: false`, `shell: false` subprocess execution).
- [ ] I have preserved all existing third-party license notices and attribution files.
- [ ] Documentation has been updated to reflect any new or modified behavior.

## Verification / Testing Done
Describe how you verified these changes (e.g. simulated automated tests, physical Android device testing on specific models and Android OS versions).
